name: Adept Total Concentration Breathing
description: (Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)You are an adept in Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting a superhuman physique while maintained. As an adept, you easily maintain it in a fight without added strain, and in daily life unless exhausted or excessively distracted. You also use it to stop your own bleeding and speed recovery.
